title: NFL Draft Plugin Configuration
description: Configuration for the NFL Draft plugin

display_duration.description: How long to display before rotating (in seconds). Uses dynamic duration when scrolling.

font.description: Font file name for player names (from assets/fonts/)

detail_font_size.description: Font size for position and pick number

pick_number_color.description: RGB color for pick numbers (default white per requirements)

scroll_speed.description: Scroll speed in pixels per second

live_refresh_interval.description: Refresh interval in seconds during live draft (default 10 minutes = 600)

projection_refresh_interval.description: Refresh interval in seconds for projected picks (default 24 hours = 86400)

draft_year.description: Draft year to display (0 = auto-detect current/upcoming draft)

logo_size.description: Size of team logo in pixels (height). Use 0 for auto-sizing based on display height.

item_gap.description: Gap in pixels between draft pick items

dynamic_duration.description: Dynamic duration settings for scroll completion

live_priority.description: Enable live priority takeover during live draft

vegas_mode.description: Override how this plugin appears in Vegas scroll mode. 'scroll' = individual picks scroll through the stream (default), 'fixed' = entire display scrolls by as one block, 'static' = scroll pauses while plugin displays for its duration.

simulate_live.description: When true, fetches real picks from a completed draft (simulate_year) via the ESPN core API and displays them as if the draft were live. Useful for testing or off-season display of actual results.

simulate_year.description: The draft year to use when simulate_live is enabled. Must be a year with a completed NFL Draft (e.g. 2025).

favorite_teams.description: Up to 3 NFL team abbreviations (e.g. ['KC', 'SF', 'DAL']). During live mode their 3 most recent picks appear at the front of the scroll. Post-draft, all picks for each team are shown in round order before the per-round sections.

post_draft_show.description: What to display during the post-draft window. 'favorites' = only picks for your favorite teams, 'rounds' = per-round results for all teams, 'both' = favorite team picks followed by per-round results.

display_rounds.description: Number of rounds to display during the post-draft window (1 = first round only, 7 = all rounds). Only applies when post_draft_show is 'rounds' or 'both'.

post_draft_days.description: Number of days after the draft ends to keep showing results. After this window the plugin goes silent until the following February.

leaders_stat_types.description: Which stat categories to show in the leaders ticker. Active May through 2 weeks post-Super Bowl.

leaders_refresh_interval.description: How often to refresh leaders data in seconds.

injury_positions.description: Only show injury/OTA entries for these positions. Leave empty to show all positions.

injury_statuses.description: Which injury statuses to include in the injury report.

show_ota_active.description: During the off-season, also show Active players who have an injury note (OTA participation reports, contract news, etc.).

injury_detail_font_size.description: Font size for the injury status and comment line.

injuries_refresh_interval.description: How often to refresh injury data in seconds.
